cost: O(n log n) build, O(n) storage. O(n+k log k) worst query time and O(log n+k) scratch; k output indexes need sorting. Balanced immutable topology gives logarithmic stack depth.
forward: Sort (start,end,index), recursively choose medians, cache maximum endpoint over each subtree. Visit left subtree unless cached maximum is below query start; stop current/right processing when current start exceeds query end. Emit intervals whose end reaches query start, then sort original indexes.
